helpful: Frozen interim context explicitly separates response requests, referrals, and amicus counts.
Snapshot filing URLs enabled targeted pre-decision retrieval without visiting the current docket.
Per-Term substantive interim counts support the required strictly-prior pooled baseline.
gaps: The response-filed cell provisioned the application but not the opposition or intervening applicant letter; both were material and had to be retrieved.
Web opens returned no readable content, and pdftotext was unavailable; in-memory urllib and pypdf extraction worked.
The published statpack exposes no build timestamp or corpus pull/snapshot vintage.
notes: The default uv cache location was read-only; a temporary writable cache allowed path resolution and validation. No corpus queries, CourtListener calls, or outcome lookups were needed. Future response-filed provisioning would benefit from including the response text and intervening letters.
